text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: high p95 latency observed in apac-region across inference-hosts (severity: P2). Spike started ~5234567800. Auto-paging to oncall.
Mia (oncall): acked, joining bridge now. creating incident channel: #bridge-5234567890
Mia (oncall): quick note — clients report degraded throughputs and intermittent 503s. Can anyone confirm control-plane or routing churn?
Elliot (sre): seeing elevated read latency to config-db replica (read-replica-apac-2). 95th ~ 1.2s. routing service retries are piling up, token queues growing.
Raj (eng-lead): confirming: router logs show ~40% of requests falling back to model-variant-slower-v1 due to timeout on policy evaluation.
Mia (oncall): current impact: elevated p95 (~800ms -> 2.1s) and tail 99 spikes, some customer timeouts. No data compromise.
Lina (pm): starting customer advisory draft. Need: ETA for mitigation, list of affected regions/customers, recommended customer messaging (we should be transparent + short).
Tom (support): which customers are hitting the slower route? can we get a quick list for support triage?
Elliot (sre): running quick mitigation: 1) route-by-region failover to ap-southeast fallback pool (less loaded), 2) increase config-db read timeout to avoid cascading retries, 3) temporarily disable non-critical routing evaluation (policy tag checks) to reduce load.
Raj (eng-lead): agree. prepping canary: set routing-policy-eval=false for 25% traffic in apac. If stable, roll to 100%.
Mia (oncall): apply mitigations now. keeping deploy window small.
incidents-bot: ACTION: mitigation toggles deployed by Mia at 5234568102 — routing-policy-eval set to 25% in apac, fallback pool active.
Elliot (sre): monitoring metrics. p95 dropping to ~1.1s after reroute. token queues decreasing.
Raj (eng-lead): also captured a short stacktrace pointing to connection pool exhaustion in config-client. patch in review: increase pool size + add backoff.
Tom (support): updating affected customers list: acme-inc, rover-ai, shopify-internal (via support ticket). I'll push a short advisory to those customers after Lina reviews.
Lina (pm): draft advisory (short): "We experienced elevated request latency in APAC between 08:05–08:25 UTC due to an internal control-plane read-replica lag. We have deployed routing mitigations which have substantially reduced latency. No customer data was affected. We're continuing to monitor and will follow up with a post-incident summary." Thoughts?
Mia (oncall): fine to send that to impacted customers. add expected ETA for full recovery: ~30–45m while replica catches up.
Elliot (sre): operational note for postmortem: investigate replica lag root cause (IO spike or replica promotion?), add circuit-breaker to config-client.
Raj (eng-lead): will prioritize the client patch and add telemetry to surface pool exhaustion earlier.
Mia (oncall): status page update (short): "Partial performance degradation in APAC affecting request latency. Mitigation in progress; we’re seeing improvement. Affected customers notified."
Tom (support): will post to affected customers and paste link to status page in their tickets.
Lina (pm): scheduling postmortem meeting in 2h. I'll own customer follow-up.
Elliot (sre): continuing to monitor. no regressions after 10m of stable p95 ~950ms.
Mia (oncall): handing off to daytime oncall @Raj at 5234568500. I'll leave the bridge open for 30m for follow-ups.
Raj (eng-lead): taking over. thanks team. leaving a short runbook note: 1) check config-db replicas, 2) validate client pool sizes, 3) confirm rollback toggles are idempotent.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: severity remains P2. bridge closed by Mia at 5234568600 (handed to Raj).
